steps.message: What is my next upcoming event in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the title only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.

Execute: adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i 'simple.*calendar\|calendar.*simple\|simplemobiletools'; ls -d /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar 2>/dev/null"
